html_source: Cigarette card of Eugene Stratton with text on the back noting that "Gene" was born in Buffalo in 1861, educated by the Christian Brothers, and employed in various jobs before joining the Haverley Minstrels in New York and coming to England in 1880. Source: Vincent Van Wyk.

search_text.text:
Cigarette card of Eugene Stratton with text on
  the back noting that "Gene" was born in Buffalo in 1861,
  educated by the Christian Brothers, and employed in various jobs
  before joining the Haverley Minstrels in New York and coming to
  England in 1880. Source: Vincent Van Wyk.
